row.evidence: Wave's collaborator guide has owners invite users by hand under Settings > User management > Users ("Only Pro Plan subscribers can invite Admins, Editors, and Viewers"); the help centre has no SCIM or SAML articles.
row.notes: No SCIM or SAML SSO at any tier; collaborators are invited and removed manually in Business settings, and Admin/Editor/Viewer roles need the Pro plan. Pro is a flat $190 USD/year per business ($19/month billed monthly), so per-user fields are null. The public GraphQL API has no collaborator management. Sign-in with Google or Apple is social login, not SSO. Status is 'none' by absence (rule 5).

plans.notes: Only Payroll Managers and Tax Pros can be added on Starter.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $190 USD/year billed annually ($19 USD/month billed monthly), per business
plans.notes: Flat price per business, not per user. sso/scim false by absence: no SAML or SCIM is documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented: Wave help-centre search for 'SCIM' returns zero articles, and collaborators are invited and removed manually.

limitations.text: No API operations to invite, update or remove collaborators.

user_api.notes: Wave's public GraphQL API covers businesses, customers, products, invoices, accounts and transactions. Its only user query returns the logged-in user, and no scope covers collaborators or roles.

fallbacks.notes: Users join by email invitation only.
